mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers hawkish monetary policy tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 3.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals weakening economic demand and labor market stress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * UNRATE) fails to produce significant negative Rank IC (below 0.03) over any 3-year window or 20-day returns in dual weakness periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown and supply chain constraints, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as predictor of 5-day returns remains below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window or average 5-day returns in rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1250 thousand units signals residential sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in HOUST < 1250 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) fails to produce significant negative Rank IC (below 0.03) over any 3-year window or 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in UNRATE > 4.0% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
